site.title: Tempura — Timing that crisps.
site.description: Premium focus-rhythm timer for desktop. Structured intervals, flexible flow, local-first. No accounts, no cloud, no sync.
site.ogDescription: Premium focus-rhythm timer for desktop. Local-first, tray-native, no accounts.
site.deck: A calm focus-rhythm timer for structured intervals and flexible flow. The session lives on your machine — tray-native, no accounts, no cloud.
site.ctaLookingUp: Looking up the latest tagged build…
site.firstBuildCooking: First tagged build is still cooking. The page will pick it up from GitHub Releases.
site.couldNotRead: Could not read GitHub just now. Releases are on GitHub.
site.latestOther: Latest is v{{tag}}. Other platforms below.
site.desktopOnly: Tempura is a desktop app. Grab a build for the computer you work on.
site.latestPick: Latest is v{{tag}}. Pick a file below.
site.taggedWaiting: v{{tag}} is tagged, but installers have not finished uploading yet.
site.couldNotReach: Could not reach GitHub. Use the releases page.
site.timerAlt: Tempura timer on Sprint: 14:54 remaining, working on Learning Tauri
site.techniqueNote: Work rhythms for the desk — not a diagnosis, and not medical advice.
site.pointClockBody: The countdown belongs to the native side, so a hidden window or a machine that slept does not cheat the session. Start, pause, skip, reset, stop — the tray tooltip stays live.
site.pointTrayBody: Tempura lives in the system tray. Closing the window hides it; quitting is a deliberate choice from the tray or Settings. Launch at login if you want it waiting with the kettle.
site.pointLocalBody: Presets, settings, and history sit in local SQLite under the app data directory. No accounts, no cloud, no sync — MIT licensed, yours to inspect.
site.installLinux: AppImage: chmod +x the file, then run it. Debian: install the .deb. Fedora and openSUSE: the .rpm. You may need FUSE for AppImage.
site.installWindows: SmartScreen may warn on the first run — the build is unsigned. More info → Run anyway, or use the MSI.
site.installMacos: Gatekeeper may block an unsigned app. Right-click the app → Open. Apple Silicon and Intel each have their own disk image.
